description: This file defines theme-related types, constants, and functions for managing UI themes in a web application, including default, dark, and light themes, as well as theme setting and loading logic.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, updates CSS variables, and saves the theme to user settings.

methods.name: setMattermostTheme
methods.description: Converts a Mattermost theme object to internal theme format and applies it.

methods.name: loadTheme
methods.description: Loads the theme from user settings or system preferences and applies it.

methods.name: initThemes
methods.description: Initializes theme settings and sets up event listeners for system theme changes.

methods.name: getSelectBaseStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS styles for customizing select dropdown components.

methods.name: getActiveThemeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently active theme.
